# B.S.R Sarona (מגדלי ב.ס.ר שרונה): project research

Prepared 2026-09-16. Purpose: background on the project a Tel Aviv broker markets as "מגדלי ב.ס.ר שרונה" / "פרויקט ב.ס.ר שרונה", where she is renting a new 4.5-room (originally 5-room) apartment with a west balcony and sea view, and a high-floor 5-room apartment with an open sea view, both advertised with a gym and a 24/7 guard.

## 0. Method and reliability notes

- Every number carries a source link and a date. Pages that show no date are marked "accessed 2026-09-16".
- "Computed" means my own arithmetic on sourced figures (for example price per sqm = price divided by the stated built area). "Inference" means my reading, not a sourced fact. "UNVERIFIED" and "Conflict" flag weak or disagreeing sources.
- Madlan list pages were read through an automated page reader. Prices and sizes came back consistent across reads, floor numbers did not, so floors from list pages are not used and only ranges are reported.
- Could not be fetched, and no workaround was attempted: TheMarker (robots.txt, so only headlines seen in search results), nadlan.gov.il (JavaScript shell with no data), tel-aviv.gov.il (HTTP 472), NTA station page (HTTP 403), he.wikipedia.org and wikidata.org (not fetchable), SkyscraperCity (HTTP 402), towers-tlv.com (robots.txt), OpenStreetMap Nominatim (robots.txt). The session's web search quota ran out partway through, so some gaps (building fees, arnona, school zones, measured walk times) could not be chased further.

## Key findings

- **Identity confirmed.** "מגדלי ב.ס.ר שרונה" is B.S.R Sarona (ב.ס.ר שרונה), the former "United Sarona" (יונייטד שרונה) purchase group project: 3 towers of about 40 floors with 420 apartments on Arania Osvaldo street (ארניה אוסוולדו), in the southern part of the Sarona complex (South Kirya), Tel Aviv. Developer and project manager: B.S.R Group. Contractor: Electra.
- **Brand new.** The occupancy certificate (Tofes 4) was received on Sunday 29 March 2026.
- **The broker's service claims check out.** A 24/7 guard, a double-height lobby and a residents' gym appear on the marketing site and in several independent listings. No developer or press source confirms a communal pool or spa.
- **Prices.** Resales inside the project in 2024 ran about ₪54,000 to ₪62,000 per sqm. In December 2025 the developer asked about ₪52,000 to ₪54,000 per sqm for 4 to 5 rooms and ₪70,000 per sqm for penthouses. Broker asking prices in 2025-2026 run about ₪50,000 to ₪73,000 per sqm for regular units (computed).
- **Rents** (asking prices, Madlan snapshot 2026-09-16). 5-room units on the project's street run about ₪14,800 to ₪18,700 a month, and 4-room units about ₪12,000 to ₪17,600. A comparable "4 rooms, originally 5" sea-view unit in a tower on Leonardo da Vinci street asks ₪17,500.
- **Not found.** The monthly building fee (va'ad bayit), the management company's name, ceiling heights, the arnona zone, official school registration zones, and walk times measured from the towers themselves.

## 1. Project identity

### 1.1 Names and history
- Current name: "ב.ס.ר שרונה" (B.S.R Sarona), marketed as "B.S.R SARONA" and "B.S.R. in Sarona, Tel Aviv". Globes describes it as the "יונייטד שרונה" purchase group that "passed over time to B.S.R's responsibility and is now called B.S.R Sarona" ([Globes, betterment levy article](https://www.globes.co.il/news/article.aspx?did=1001532418), page undated; [B.S.R project page](https://bsr.co.il/en/project/b-s-r-in-sarona-tel-aviv/), accessed 2026-09-16).
- Project TLV files it as "פרויקט מתחם רשות השידור - דרום הקריה" (Broadcasting Authority compound, South Kirya) ([Project TLV](https://project-tlv.info/places/sarona/rashut/), accessed 2026-09-16). The land, about 9 dunams, was formerly used by the Israel Broadcasting Authority ([Globes English](https://en.globes.co.il/en/article-united-sarona-woes-deepen-1001312476), 2019-12-25; [Globes](https://www.globes.co.il/news/article.aspx?did=1001539540), 2026).
- The group was organized in 2016 by Minhal Megurim LeIsrael ([Globes English](https://en.globes.co.il/en/article-united-sarona-woes-deepen-1001312476), 2019-12-25). B.S.R replaced the group's original management company in October 2017 ([Nadlancenter](https://www.nadlancenter.co.il/article/14233), 2026-03-30).

### 1.2 Developer, owners, partners, team
- Developer and project manager: B.S.R Group (קבוצת ב.ס.ר). Dun's 100 lists Eng. Nachshon Kivity as chairman and owner and Bezalel Eyal as CEO ([Dun's 100](https://www.duns100.co.il/en/BSR_Group), profile tied to the 2020 ranking).
- Owners: the apartments belong to purchase group members. B.S.R's chairman still had 12 apartments and 9 penthouses for sale in December 2025 ([ynet](https://www.ynet.co.il/economy/article/yokra14612226), 2025-12-14). Inference: a rental here is most likely offered on behalf of an individual member-owner.
- Commercial component: Beit Sayag (בית סייג), controlled by Roy Gil, bought 40 commercial units from a company named BRP for about ₪160 million. Gil also holds 9% of B.S.R's shares. On 2025-08-18 the Tel Aviv District Court ordered the group's representatives to disclose information about the deal ([Calcalist](https://www.calcalist.co.il/real-estate/article/s1zcdkykex), 2025-08-25).
- Largest office tenant: Wiz, which leased 4,500 sqm, with a staff dining room on the retail floor run by restaurateur Ruti Broudo ([Nadlancenter](https://www.nadlancenter.co.il/article/14233), 2026-03-30). Globes English described Wiz leasing a renovated 5-floor, 5,500 sqm building on Arania street "behind the BSR buildings", owned by Roy Gil's Beit Sayag Sarona group ([Globes English](https://en.globes.co.il/en/article-wiz-leases-five-floors-in-renovated-sarona-building-1001503536), 2025-03-02). **Conflict:** 4,500 vs 5,500 sqm, and it is unclear whether both reports describe the same space.
- Architects: Moshe Tzur Architects & Town Planners together with CityBee ([B.S.R](https://bsr.co.il/en/project/b-s-r-in-sarona-tel-aviv/), accessed 2026-09-16; [Globes](https://www.globes.co.il/news/article.aspx?did=1001539540), 2026). The marketing site credits the lobbies to Perry Davidowitz Architects ([marketing site](https://sarona.brickmancamp.co.il/), accessed 2026-09-16). The preserved building at Arania 8, next to Tower C, lists its own team: developer "טמפלרים בשרונה", architect Master Gal ([Project TLV, Arania 8](https://project-tlv.info/buildings/%D7%A8%D7%97%D7%95%D7%91-%D7%90%D7%A8%D7%A0%D7%99%D7%94-%D7%90%D7%95%D7%A1%D7%95%D7%95%D7%9C%D7%93%D7%95/%D7%A4%D7%A8%D7%95%D7%99%D7%A7%D7%98-%D7%90%D7%A8%D7%A0%D7%99%D7%94-8/), accessed 2026-09-16).
- Contractor: Electra Building (general contractor), with Electra M&E, Electra Elevators and Alimak ([Electra](https://www.electra.co.il/en/electra_building/projects/bsr_sarona), accessed 2026-09-16). The construction agreement was ₪600 million ([ynet](https://www.ynet.co.il/articles/0,7340,L-4909274,00.html), 2017-01-18). Other suppliers: Termokir, for waterproofing and tiling systems ([Termokir](https://www.termokir.co.il/projects/urban/%D7%91-%D7%A1-%D7%A8-%D7%A9%D7%A8%D7%95%D7%A0%D7%94-%D7%AA%D7%9C-%D7%90%D7%91%D7%99%D7%91/), accessed 2026-09-16), and WAWA, for green building, wind and energy consulting ([WAWA](https://eng.gbwawa.com/portfolio-item/b-s-r-sarona-tel-aviv/), 2018-08-02).

### 1.3 Address, position, plot
- Addresses:
  - Official: "6 Oswaldo Aranha, Tel Aviv" ([B.S.R](https://bsr.co.il/en/project/b-s-r-in-sarona-tel-aviv/), accessed 2026-09-16).
  - Madlan: "ארניה אסוולדו 8" ([Madlan project page](https://www.madlan.co.il/projects/UNITED%20SARONA), accessed 2026-09-16).
  - Project TLV: "ארניה אוסוולדו 8-18", and lists each tower together with a preserved building: Tower C with no. 8 (described as "צמוד למגדל C", adjacent to Tower C), Tower B with no. 14, Tower A with no. 18. A kindergarten cluster is at no. 14א ([Project TLV street page](https://project-tlv.info/buildings/%D7%A8%D7%97%D7%95%D7%91-%D7%90%D7%A8%D7%A0%D7%99%D7%94-%D7%90%D7%95%D7%A1%D7%95%D7%95%D7%9C%D7%93%D7%95/), accessed 2026-09-16).
  - Madlan rental cards on the street use nos. 6, 8, 10, 14 and 16; the no. 16 listing page is explicitly tagged "BSR Sarona", and a Concord listing title seen in search results tagged no. 10 as "פרויקט בסר" (that page now returns 404) ([Madlan street rentals](https://www.madlan.co.il/for-rent/%D7%90%D7%A8%D7%A0%D7%99%D7%94-%D7%90%D7%A1%D7%95%D7%95%D7%9C%D7%93%D7%95-%D7%AA%D7%9C-%D7%90%D7%91%D7%99%D7%91-%D7%99%D7%A4%D7%95-%D7%99%D7%A9%D7%A8%D7%90%D7%9C), accessed 2026-09-16; [Madlan listing, no. 16](https://www.madlan.co.il/listings/7B6vPjc4coV), accessed 2026-09-16). One B.S.R listing uses a Leonardo da Vinci street address ([Society4U](https://society4u.co.il/RealEstate/PropertyDisplay.aspx?PropertyId=14961), undated).
  - ImmoIsrael calls Building C "the northern building" ([ImmoIsrael](https://www.immoisrael.com/listings/4-room-apartment-rent-arania-osvaldo-street-tel-aviv), 2026-05-19).
  - **UNVERIFIED:** the exact postal address of each tower.
- Position:
  - South of the Sarona Market complex ([Globes](https://www.globes.co.il/news/article.aspx?did=1001539540), 2026).
  - The towers form the "western wall" of the Sarona complex, the transition between the business district along the Ayalon and the residential neighborhoods to the west ([CityBee](https://www.citybee-arch.com/projects/all-en/united-sarona/), accessed 2026-09-16).
  - The Landmark towers sit immediately south, at Arania Osvaldo 20 / HaArba'a 13-15 / Da Vinci 2-4 ([Project TLV, Landmark](https://project-tlv.info/places/sarona/7-2/), accessed 2026-09-16).
- Plot:
  - About 9 dunams ([Globes](https://www.globes.co.il/news/article.aspx?did=1001539540), 2026; [ynet](https://www.ynet.co.il/economy/article/SJLmclHid), 2021-06-15).
  - Gush/helka and the project's own plan number: NOT found.
  - A TASE-filed appraisal of the neighboring Ganei Sarona western compound (gush 7101, plots 24, 25, 26, 28) cites plan TA/3000 (published 2006-09-25) and describes B.S.R Sarona among the surrounding South Kirya projects ([TASE appraisal](https://mayafiles.tase.co.il/rpdf/1584001-1585000/P1584313-01.pdf), report dated 2024-03-28). **UNVERIFIED:** whether TA/3000 also governs the B.S.R plot.

### 1.4 Program: towers, floors, units, other uses
- Towers: 3.
- Floors, **Conflict** (38 to 40, depending on the source and on how the office podium is counted):
  - "כ-40 קומות" ([Globes](https://www.globes.co.il/news/article.aspx?did=1001539540), 2026); 40 ([Electra](https://www.electra.co.il/en/electra_building/projects/bsr_sarona), accessed 2026-09-16; [ynet](https://www.ynet.co.il/economy/article/yokra14612226), 2025-12-14).
  - "three 39-story residential towers situated atop 5 floors of offices and commercial space" ([B.S.R](https://bsr.co.il/en/project/b-s-r-in-sarona-tel-aviv/), accessed 2026-09-16). Termokir uses the same description ([Termokir](https://www.termokir.co.il/projects/urban/%D7%91-%D7%A1-%D7%A8-%D7%A9%D7%A8%D7%95%D7%A0%D7%94-%D7%AA%D7%9C-%D7%90%D7%91%D7%99%D7%91/), accessed 2026-09-16).
  - 38 ([Madlan project page](https://www.madlan.co.il/projects/UNITED%20SARONA), accessed 2026-09-16; [Project TLV](https://project-tlv.info/places/sarona/rashut/), accessed 2026-09-16).
  - Listings: "14 of 39" ([Madlan listing](https://www.madlan.co.il/listings/7B6vPjc4coV), accessed 2026-09-16), "16/38" ([ImmoIsrael](https://www.immoisrael.com/listings/4-room-apartment-rent-arania-osvaldo-street-tel-aviv), 2026-05-19), "Floor 20 out of 40" ([Janglo](https://www.janglo.net/item/5dACmuQdUpL), 2026-04-29).
- Height: **UNVERIFIED.** A SkyscraperCity forum thread title seen in search results says "3x146m", but the page could not be opened.
- Units: 420 ([Electra](https://www.electra.co.il/en/electra_building/projects/bsr_sarona), accessed 2026-09-16; [Globes](https://www.globes.co.il/news/article.aspx?did=1001539540), 2026; [Nadlancenter](https://www.nadlancenter.co.il/article/14233), 2026-03-30; [ynet](https://www.ynet.co.il/economy/article/yokra14612226), 2025-12-14).
  - The tender-stage plan had 324 units, later increased by 96 ([Globes, levy article](https://www.globes.co.il/news/article.aspx?did=1001532418), undated).
  - In 2017 the plan was 3 towers of 37 floors with 390 units ([ynet](https://www.ynet.co.il/articles/0,7340,L-4909274,00.html), 2017-01-18). Electra Construction's older page shows 3 towers of 35 floors with 387 units ([Electra Construction](https://www.electra-construction.co.il/en/projects/mega_projects/united_sarona), accessed 2026-09-16).
- Non-residential:
  - 8,000 sqm of offices, 4,000 sqm of retail, and 4,000 sqm of public areas including classrooms, kindergartens and daycare, plus 3 preserved Templer buildings ([ynet](https://www.ynet.co.il/economy/article/yokra14612226), 2025-12-14).
  - Other totals: Electra gives 61,000 sqm residential and 20,000 sqm of offices and commerce ([Electra](https://www.electra.co.il/en/electra_building/projects/bsr_sarona), accessed 2026-09-16), and Globes gives 12,000 sqm of commerce and employment ([Globes](https://www.globes.co.il/news/article.aspx?did=1001539540), 2026).
  - An underground passage links the whole complex ([Nadlancenter](https://www.nadlancenter.co.il/article/14233), 2026-03-30).
  - Electra also built an underground road for the municipality, and hung the 3 heritage buildings on steel beams during construction ([Electra, Hebrew page](https://www.electra.co.il/%D7%90%D7%9C%D7%A7%D7%98%D7%A8%D7%94_%D7%91%D7%99%D7%9C%D7%93%D7%99%D7%A0%D7%92/%D7%A4%D7%A8%D7%95%D7%99%D7%A7%D7%98%D7%99%D7%9D/%D7%91_%D7%A1_%D7%A8_%D7%A9%D7%A8%D7%95%D7%A0%D7%94), accessed 2026-09-16).

### 1.5 Timeline and 2026 status
- **Land.** The ILA tender was published in July 2015 and closed in March 2016 ([Globes](https://www.globes.co.il/news/article.aspx?did=1001539540), 2026). Nadlancenter dates the group's ₪1.24 billion win to April 2016 and puts total cost at about ₪2.6 billion including land ([Nadlancenter](https://www.nadlancenter.co.il/article/14233), 2026-03-30; also [ynet](https://www.ynet.co.il/economy/article/SJLmclHid), 2021-06-15). **Conflict:** ynet in 2017 and WAWA in 2018 cite about ₪1.06 billion for the land, without explaining the basis ([ynet](https://www.ynet.co.il/articles/0,7340,L-4909274,00.html), 2017-01-18; [WAWA](https://eng.gbwawa.com/portfolio-item/b-s-r-sarona-tel-aviv/), 2018-08-02).
- **Building permit.** The full permit was in hand by June 2021, when works were reported as starting "this month" ([ynet](https://www.ynet.co.il/economy/article/SJLmclHid), 2021-06-15). **Conflict:** Globes says construction "officially" began in Q4 2022 ([Globes](https://www.globes.co.il/news/article.aspx?did=1001539540), 2026).
- **Disputes.** An arbitration by a retired Supreme Court justice ruled against about 20 defaulting members, with about ₪15 million owed to the group fund ([Maariv](https://www.maariv.co.il/business/economic/israel/Article-925328), 2022-06-16). Members paid about 60% more than the initial estimate ([ynet](https://www.ynet.co.il/economy/article/yokra14612226), 2025-12-14).
- **Betterment levy.** An appraiser set it at ₪98 million, against ₪127 million demanded by the local committee and ₪28 million claimed by the group ([Globes, levy article](https://www.globes.co.il/news/article.aspx?did=1001532418), page undated; Project TLV logs this story on 2026-01-13).
- **Completion forecasts.** Electra's page still shows expected completion in June 2025 ([Electra](https://www.electra.co.il/en/electra_building/projects/bsr_sarona), accessed 2026-09-16). In December 2025 B.S.R expected Tofes 4 in Q1 2026 ([ynet](https://www.ynet.co.il/economy/article/yokra14612226), 2025-12-14).
- **Tofes 4: received Sunday 29 March 2026.**
  - Nadlancenter, dated 2026-03-30, says it was received "last night (Sunday)" ([Nadlancenter](https://www.nadlancenter.co.il/article/14233)).
  - TheMarker's 2026-03-29 headline says all three United Sarona towers received an occupancy permit ([TheMarker](https://www.themarker.com/realestate/2026-03-29/ty-article/.highlight/0000019d-3a23-d143-a1fd-3e37463a0000); headline only, article not fetchable).
  - Globes: "at the end of last month it happened" ([Globes](https://www.globes.co.il/news/article.aspx?did=1001539540), 2026, page undated).
- **Status, September 2026.** Completed and in occupancy.
  - Rentals are advertised with June 2026 entry ([ImmoIsrael](https://www.immoisrael.com/listings/4-room-apartment-rent-arania-osvaldo-street-tel-aviv), 2026-05-19; [Madlan listing](https://www.madlan.co.il/listings/7B6vPjc4coV), accessed 2026-09-16).
  - The marketing site offers "Skyline Suites" penthouses "with immediate occupancy" ([marketing site](https://sarona.brickmancamp.co.il/), accessed 2026-09-16).
  - B.S.R's own site still tags the project "For Sale" ([B.S.R residential projects](https://bsr.co.il/en/project-category/residence/), accessed 2026-09-16).
- **Note on "management fees."** Globes estimates B.S.R's total management-fee income from the project at about ₪81.3 million ([Globes](https://www.globes.co.il/news/article.aspx?did=1001539540), 2026). That is B.S.R's project management income, not a residents' building fee.

## 2. Building amenities and services

- **24/7 guard and security: verified.**
  - Marketing site: "מערכת שמירה ואבטחה 24/7" and "חברת ניהול שמירה ואחזקה 24/7" ([marketing site](https://sarona.brickmancamp.co.il/), accessed 2026-09-16).
  - Listings: "24/7 guarding and security system" ([Concord](https://www.concord-tlv.co.il/property/arania-osvaldo-street-sarona-neighborhood/?lang=en), modified 2025-02-05); "24/7 security guard" ([Janglo](https://www.janglo.net/item/5dACmuQdUpL), 2026-04-29); "שומר בלובי 24/7" ([owner listing page](https://sharona-skyline-living.lovable.app/), undated).
- **Lobby: verified.** "לובי מפואר עם חלל כפול" (double height) ([marketing site](https://sarona.brickmancamp.co.il/), accessed 2026-09-16). Also "reception lobby with security desk" ([Israeli Brokers](https://israelibrokers.co.il/buildings/bsr-sarona-tel-aviv-b-798), accessed 2026-09-16).
- **Gym and residents' club: verified by multiple listings.**
  - "well-equipped and luxurious gym and tenants' club" ([Concord](https://www.concord-tlv.co.il/property/arania-osvaldo-street-sarona-neighborhood/?lang=en), 2025-02-05).
  - "gym and residents' club" ([MyPlace](https://www.myplace.co.il/en/apartment-for-sale/%D7%91%D7%A9%D7%A8%D7%95%D7%A0%D7%94-4-%D7%97%D7%93%D7%A8%D7%99%D7%9D-%D7%A2%D7%9D-%D7%9E%D7%97%D7%A1%D7%9F-%D7%95%D7%97%D7%A0%D7%99%D7%94/), modified 2025-11-11).
  - "Gym in Building C, for residents of the complex only" ([Janglo](https://www.janglo.net/item/5dACmuQdUpL), 2026-04-29).
  - Residents' lounge and gym ([Peer](https://peer-lre.com/properties/%D7%93%D7%99%D7%A8%D7%AA-4-%D7%97%D7%93-%D7%91%D7%9E%D7%92%D7%93%D7%9C%D7%99-%D7%91%D7%A1%D7%A8-%D7%A9%D7%A8%D7%95%D7%A0%D7%94-%D7%AA%D7%B4%D7%90/), undated). Gym ([ImmoIsrael](https://www.immoisrael.com/listings/4-room-apartment-rent-arania-osvaldo-street-tel-aviv), 2026-05-19).
- **Pool and spa: NOT verified, probably no communal pool.**
  - No developer, contractor or press source mentions a communal pool or spa.
  - ynet reports that only 2 of the 9 remaining penthouses have potential for a private rooftop pool ([ynet](https://www.ynet.co.il/economy/article/yokra14612226), 2025-12-14).
  - "Pool" appears only in generic feature checklists on broker sites, not in their own descriptions ([MyPlace](https://www.myplace.co.il/en/apartment-for-sale/%D7%91%D7%A9%D7%A8%D7%95%D7%A0%D7%94-4-%D7%97%D7%93%D7%A8%D7%99%D7%9D-%D7%A2%D7%9D-%D7%9E%D7%97%D7%A1%D7%9F-%D7%95%D7%97%D7%A0%D7%99%D7%94/), 2025-11-11; [NY Realty](https://nyg.co.il/en/project/%D7%AA%D7%9C-%D7%90%D7%91%D7%99%D7%91-%D7%A9%D7%A8%D7%95%D7%A0%D7%94-%D7%9E%D7%99%D7%A0%D7%99-%D7%A4%D7%A0%D7%98%D7%94%D7%90%D7%95%D7%96-%D7%A0%D7%95%D7%A3-%D7%9E%D7%A2%D7%A8%D7%91%D7%99-%D7%9C/), 2026-04-22).
- **Elevators.**
  - 25 elevators in the project, 12 of them running at 4 m/s and serving 43 stops ([Electra](https://www.electra.co.il/en/electra_building/projects/bsr_sarona), accessed 2026-09-16).
  - "4 מעליות מהירות לכל מגדל" ([marketing site](https://sarona.brickmancamp.co.il/), accessed 2026-09-16), repeated by [Concord](https://www.concord-tlv.co.il/property/arania-osvaldo-street-sarona-neighborhood/?lang=en) (2025-02-05). Twelve fast elevators across 3 towers matches 4 per tower.
  - NY Realty's "6 elevators" is a low-confidence outlier.
- **Parking.**
  - 5 underground levels ([Electra](https://www.electra.co.il/en/electra_building/projects/bsr_sarona), accessed 2026-09-16), with an LPR (license plate recognition) system ([marketing site](https://sarona.brickmancamp.co.il/), accessed 2026-09-16).
  - In 2021, 180 apartments were not to get an attached parking space, with allocation by lottery ([ynet](https://www.ynet.co.il/economy/article/SJLmclHid), 2021-06-15). Check whether a given rental includes a space.
  - Listings that include parking: 1 space ([ImmoIsrael](https://www.immoisrael.com/listings/4-room-apartment-rent-arania-osvaldo-street-tel-aviv), 2026-05-19); private parking ([MyPlace](https://www.myplace.co.il/en/apartment-for-sale/%D7%91%D7%A9%D7%A8%D7%95%D7%A0%D7%94-4-%D7%97%D7%93%D7%A8%D7%99%D7%9D-%D7%A2%D7%9D-%D7%9E%D7%97%D7%A1%D7%9F-%D7%95%D7%97%D7%A0%D7%99%D7%94/), 2025-11-11).
- **Storage.** A registered storage room ([MyPlace](https://www.myplace.co.il/en/apartment-for-sale/%D7%91%D7%A9%D7%A8%D7%95%D7%A0%D7%94-4-%D7%97%D7%93%D7%A8%D7%99%D7%9D-%D7%A2%D7%9D-%D7%9E%D7%97%D7%A1%D7%9F-%D7%95%D7%97%D7%A0%D7%99%D7%94/), 2025-11-11); storage included ([ImmoIsrael](https://www.immoisrael.com/listings/4-room-apartment-rent-arania-osvaldo-street-tel-aviv), 2026-05-19; [owner listing page](https://sharona-skyline-living.lovable.app/), undated). **UNVERIFIED:** whether all units have storage.
- **Air conditioning.** Per-apartment VRF: the marketing site writes "מיזוג VRP דירתי", probably a typo for VRF ([marketing site](https://sarona.brickmancamp.co.il/), accessed 2026-09-16). VRF also appears on [NY Realty](https://nyg.co.il/en/project/%D7%AA%D7%9C-%D7%90%D7%91%D7%99%D7%91-%D7%A9%D7%A8%D7%95%D7%A0%D7%94-%D7%9E%D7%99%D7%A0%D7%99-%D7%A4%D7%A0%D7%98%D7%94%D7%90%D7%95%D7%96-%D7%A0%D7%95%D7%A3-%D7%9E%D7%A2%D7%A8%D7%91%D7%99-%D7%9C/) (2026-04-22).
- **Smart home: UNVERIFIED.** It appears only as a generic checklist item on NY Realty. Israeli Brokers mentions "smart building management systems" without detail ([Israeli Brokers](https://israelibrokers.co.il/buildings/bsr-sarona-tel-aviv-b-798), accessed 2026-09-16).
- **Green building.**
  - WAWA provided green building consulting, wind simulations (CFD) and energy analysis.
  - The 2018 design included a pneumatic waste system, green roofs, water harvesting for toilet flushing and irrigation (WAWA cites about half of garden needs), and a building management system for energy ([WAWA, Hebrew](https://www.gbwawa.com/portfolio-item/%D7%91%D7%A1%D7%A8-%D7%A9%D7%A8%D7%95%D7%A0%D7%94-%D7%AA%D7%9C-%D7%90%D7%91%D7%99%D7%91/), 2018-08-02).
  - An Israeli green building (SI 5281) star rating was NOT found.
- **Kindergartens and public facilities.** A kindergarten cluster (אשכול גנים) at Arania 14א, 4 floors, planned to open in September 2025 ([Project TLV](https://project-tlv.info/places/sarona/%D7%A4%D7%A8%D7%95%D7%99%D7%A7%D7%98-%D7%90%D7%A9%D7%9B%D7%95%D7%9C-%D7%92%D7%A0%D7%99%D7%9D-%D7%92%D7%A0%D7%99-%D7%A9%D7%A8%D7%95%D7%A0%D7%94-%D7%9E%D7%92%D7%93%D7%9C%D7%99-%D7%91%D7%A1%D7%A8/), accessed 2026-09-16). Also [ynet](https://www.ynet.co.il/economy/article/yokra14612226) (2025-12-14) on public areas for classrooms, kindergartens and daycare.
- **Management company and monthly va'ad bayit: NOT found in any source.** The marketing site mentions a 24/7 guarding and maintenance management company without naming it.

## 3. Apartment specs typical for the project

- **Unit mix.** In December 2025 the developer's remaining stock was 4 to 5 room apartments averaging 90 to 130 sqm, plus penthouses of 240 to 500 sqm on the high floors ([ynet](https://www.ynet.co.il/economy/article/yokra14612226), 2025-12-14). Smaller units also exist: a 2-room, 50 sqm unit sold in 2021 ([Globes](https://www.globes.co.il/news/article.aspx?did=1001539540), 2026).
- **4 rooms**
  - 103 sqm + 9 sqm balcony, floor 14 of 39, park view ([Madlan listing](https://www.madlan.co.il/listings/7B6vPjc4coV), accessed 2026-09-16).
  - 103 sqm + 9 sqm balcony, floor 16/38, Building C ([ImmoIsrael](https://www.immoisrael.com/listings/4-room-apartment-rent-arania-osvaldo-street-tel-aviv), 2026-05-19).
  - 103.3 sqm + 9 sqm balcony, Tower A, floor 12, south-east, with a parents' suite and safe room ([owner listing page](https://sharona-skyline-living.lovable.app/), undated; duplicate page [here](https://my-dreamy-home-page.lovable.app/)).
  - 107 sqm + 9 sqm balcony, floor 11 ([Concord](https://www.concord-tlv.co.il/property/arania-osvaldo-street-sarona-neighborhood/?lang=en), 2025-02-05).
  - 104 sqm + 21 sqm terrace, south and east ([Peer](https://peer-lre.com/properties/%D7%93%D7%99%D7%A8%D7%AA-4-%D7%97%D7%93-%D7%91%D7%9E%D7%92%D7%93%D7%9C%D7%99-%D7%91%D7%A1%D7%A8-%D7%A9%D7%A8%D7%95%D7%A0%D7%94-%D7%AA%D7%B4%D7%90/), undated).
  - 104 sqm built / 113 sqm total, floor 10, south and east ([MyPlace](https://www.myplace.co.il/en/apartment-for-sale/%D7%91%D7%A9%D7%A8%D7%95%D7%A0%D7%94-4-%D7%97%D7%93%D7%A8%D7%99%D7%9D-%D7%A2%D7%9D-%D7%9E%D7%97%D7%A1%D7%9F-%D7%95%D7%97%D7%A0%D7%99%D7%94/), 2025-11-11).
- **5 rooms**
  - 116 sqm, floor 20, sold March 2024 ([Globes](https://www.globes.co.il/news/article.aspx?did=1001539540), 2026).
  - 117 sqm + 14 sqm sun balcony, floor 20, open north-west sea views ([Janglo](https://www.janglo.net/item/5dACmuQdUpL), 2026-04-29).
  - 121 sqm built + 14 sqm balcony, 4 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms plus a guest toilet, west and south, "tower overlooking the sea", floor 15 of 39 ([Society4U](https://society4u.co.il/RealEstate/PropertyDisplay.aspx?PropertyId=14961), undated, marked sold).
  - Madlan rental cards for 5-room units on the street show 114 to 136 sqm ([Madlan, 5-room rentals on the street](https://www.madlan.co.il/for-rent/%D7%90%D7%A8%D7%A0%D7%99%D7%94-%D7%90%D7%A1%D7%95%D7%95%D7%9C%D7%93%D7%95-%D7%AA%D7%9C-%D7%90%D7%91%D7%99%D7%91-%D7%99%D7%A4%D7%95-%D7%99%D7%A9%D7%A8%D7%90%D7%9C/5-bd), accessed 2026-09-16).
- **4.5 rooms ("originally 5").** No source describes a 4.5-room layout in this project. Inference: a converted 5-room unit would likely be in the same size band as the 5-room units above, about 114 to 121 sqm plus about 14 sqm of balcony, but this depends on the unit. Ask for the built and balcony areas.
- **Penthouses**
  - "Skyline Suites" with three exposures and balconies facing the park to the east and the sea to the west; tours show floors 35 and 36 ([marketing site](https://sarona.brickmancamp.co.il/), accessed 2026-09-16).
  - Mini penthouse, 210 sqm + 53 sqm balcony, floors 36 to 38, western exposure ([NY Realty](https://nyg.co.il/en/project/%D7%AA%D7%9C-%D7%90%D7%91%D7%99%D7%91-%D7%A9%D7%A8%D7%95%D7%A0%D7%94-%D7%9E%D7%99%D7%A0%D7%99-%D7%A4%D7%A0%D7%98%D7%94%D7%90%D7%95%D7%96-%D7%A0%D7%95%D7%A3-%D7%9E%D7%A2%D7%A8%D7%91%D7%99-%D7%9C/), 2026-04-22).
- **Listings that describe sea views** on the western side: floor 15, west and south ([Society4U](https://society4u.co.il/RealEstate/PropertyDisplay.aspx?PropertyId=14961), undated); floor 20, north-west ([Janglo](https://www.janglo.net/item/5dACmuQdUpL), 2026-04-29); floors 36 to 38, west ([NY Realty](https://nyg.co.il/en/project/%D7%AA%D7%9C-%D7%90%D7%91%D7%99%D7%91-%D7%A9%D7%A8%D7%95%D7%A0%D7%94-%D7%9E%D7%99%D7%A0%D7%99-%D7%A4%D7%A0%D7%98%D7%94%D7%90%D7%95%D7%96-%D7%A0%D7%95%D7%A3-%D7%9E%D7%A2%D7%A8%D7%91%D7%99-%D7%9C/), 2026-04-22).
- **Early design reference.** As marketed in 2017, a typical apartment was about 106 sqm + 20 sqm balcony ([ynet](https://www.ynet.co.il/articles/0,7340,L-4909274,00.html), 2017-01-18).
- **Finishing standard** (as described by marketing and brokers, not verified on site):
  - Parquet in the bedrooms and a "designed, luxurious kitchen" ([marketing site](https://sarona.brickmancamp.co.il/), accessed 2026-09-16).
  - Floor-to-ceiling windows, upgraded doors and sanitary ware, parquet ([Madlan listing](https://www.madlan.co.il/listings/7B6vPjc4coV), accessed 2026-09-16).
  - Kitchen with a 3 m island and granite countertop, built-in closets, master suite, safe room ([Janglo](https://www.janglo.net/item/5dACmuQdUpL), 2026-04-29).
- **Ceiling heights: NOT found in any source.**

- September 2024: 4 rooms, 106 sqm, floor 25, ₪5.9 million, about ₪55,650 per sqm ([Globes](https://www.globes.co.il/news/article.aspx?did=1001539540), 2026).
- February 2024: 4 rooms, 104 sqm, floor 30, ₪5.64 million, about ₪54,250 per sqm ([Globes](https://www.globes.co.il/news/article.aspx?did=1001539540), 2026).

  - November 2021: 2 rooms, 50 sqm, ₪3.67 million, ₪73,400 per sqm.

## 5. Location intelligence

**Caveat:** no verified coordinates for the towers could be obtained, and no routing service could be used. Walk times below come from a named source with its own reference point, or are marked as rough. Moovit's reference point is the Sarona complex address at Aluf Albert Mendler 3, not the towers. Confirm door-to-door times in a maps app from Arania Osvaldo street.

- **Sarona Market and Sarona Park: immediately adjacent.**
  - Globes places the project south of the Sarona Market complex ([Globes](https://www.globes.co.il/news/article.aspx?did=1001539540), 2026).
  - Zips lists Sarona Market within about 40 m of Arania Osvaldo street, and the Landmark mall within about 20 m ([Zips](https://zips.co.il/street/%D7%AA%D7%9C-%D7%90%D7%91%D7%99%D7%91-%D7%99%D7%A4%D7%95/%D7%90%D7%A8%D7%A0%D7%99%D7%94-%D7%90%D7%A1%D7%95%D7%95%D7%9C%D7%93%D7%95), accessed 2026-09-16). The owner page says "Sarona Park and Sarona Market below the building" ([owner listing page](https://sharona-skyline-living.lovable.app/), undated).
  - Sarona Market opened in 2015 and covers 8,700 sqm ([Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sarona_Market), accessed 2026-09-16). The marketing site describes Sarona Park as 40 dunams of green space ([marketing site](https://sarona.brickmancamp.co.il/), accessed 2026-09-16).
- **Red Line.** Operating since 2023-08-18 ([Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Red_Line_(Tel_Aviv_Light_Rail)), accessed 2026-09-16). Both Yehudit and Carlebach are Red Line stations. Inference: Yehudit is the closest one to the towers, since its exit A serves the Sarona complex; Carlebach is the next stop south.
  - **Yehudit station:** underground, on Begin Road opposite Yehudit Blvd, entrance between HaArba'a and HaHashmonaim ([Project TLV](https://project-tlv.info/places/transportation/train/yehudit/), accessed 2026-09-16).
  - Entrances: A at "מקלף 1", exiting to Kiryat HaMemshala and the Sarona complex; B at Begin 112; C at Begin 98; D at "אלברט מנדל 38" ([Tevel Metro, Yehudit](https://www.tevelmetro.co.il/stations/%D7%99%D7%94%D7%95%D7%93%D7%99%D7%AA/), accessed 2026-09-16).
  - Moovit puts the "ת.רק"ל יהודית/דרך מנחם בגין" bus stop 5 minutes' walk from its Sarona reference point ([Moovit](https://moovitapp.com/index/en/public_transit-%D7%9E%D7%AA%D7%97%D7%9D_%D7%A9%D7%A8%D7%95%D7%A0%D7%94-Israel-site_33024977-1), accessed 2026-09-16).
  - **Carlebach station:** entrances at Carlebach/Lincoln (TLV Mall) and Carlebach/Begin; neighbors are Yehudit to the north and Allenby to the south ([Tevel Metro, Carlebach](https://www.tevelmetro.co.il/stations/%D7%A7%D7%A8%D7%9C%D7%99%D7%91%D7%9A/), accessed 2026-09-16). No verified walk time.
- **Purple Line: no station near the towers per these sources.**
  - Under construction. Wikipedia says it is expected to open in 2028 and that the first vehicle was delivered in June 2026 ([Wikipedia, Purple Line](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Purple_Line_(Tel_Aviv_Light_Rail)), accessed 2026-09-16). **Conflict:** Wikipedia's light rail overview still shows "est. 2027" ([Wikipedia, Tel Aviv Light Rail](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tel_Aviv_Light_Rail), accessed 2026-09-16).
  - In central Tel Aviv it runs along Arlozorov, Ben Yehuda, Allenby, Aliya and Levinsky, interchanging with the Red Line at Arlozorov and Yehuda HaLevi ([Wikipedia, Purple Line](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Purple_Line_(Tel_Aviv_Light_Rail))).
  - Project TLV's Tel Aviv station list has nothing at Sarona or on Begin Road ([Project TLV, Purple Line](https://project-tlv.info/places/transportation/train/purple/), modified 2026-09-02).
- **Green Line.**
  - Under construction. Project TLV lists underground stations including Carlebach (shared with the Red Line) and Kaplan, with expected opening in 2028 ([Project TLV, Green Line](https://project-tlv.info/places/transportation/train/green/), accessed 2026-09-16).
  - Wikipedia gives 2028 for the southern section and 2030 for the whole line ([Wikipedia, Green Line](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Green_Line_(Tel_Aviv_Light_Rail)), accessed 2026-09-16).
  - **UNVERIFIED:** the exact Kaplan station location and the walk time to it.
- **Metro.** Cornerstone laid 2025-12-18; tender launched 2026-08-24 ([Project TLV, Metro](https://project-tlv.info/places/transportation/metro/), accessed 2026-09-16). Stations near Sarona not verified.
- **Tel Aviv HaShalom railway station.**
  - In the Ayalon median at the HaShalom interchange, with entrances on the north side of HaShalom Road and by bridge from Azrieli Center ([Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tel_Aviv_HaShalom_railway_station), accessed 2026-09-16).
  - Moovit: 1,702 m, a 23-minute walk from its Sarona reference point ([Moovit](https://moovitapp.com/index/en/public_transit-%D7%9E%D7%AA%D7%97%D7%9D_%D7%A9%D7%A8%D7%95%D7%A0%D7%94-Israel-site_33024977-1), accessed 2026-09-16). Caveat: the same page names Arlozorov (26 minutes) as the closest light rail station, which looks outdated, so treat Moovit's figures as rough.
- **Azrieli Center.** Moovit puts the "קניון עזריאלי/דרך מנחם בגין" bus stop 7 minutes' walk from its Sarona reference point ([Moovit](https://moovitapp.com/index/en/public_transit-%D7%9E%D7%AA%D7%97%D7%9D_%D7%A9%D7%A8%D7%95%D7%A0%D7%94-Israel-site_33024977-1), accessed 2026-09-16). Shturem lists Azrieli Center as within walking distance ([Shturem](https://shturem.co.il/en/projects/b-s-r-sarona-project/), accessed 2026-09-16).
- **Ayalon Highway.** The nearest interchange is HaShalom, listed as "Peace Interchange" ([Wikipedia, Ayalon Highway](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ayalon_Highway), accessed 2026-09-16). A broker describes "easy access to the Ayalon Highway" ([MyPlace](https://www.myplace.co.il/en/apartment-for-sale/%D7%91%D7%A9%D7%A8%D7%95%D7%A0%D7%94-4-%D7%97%D7%93%D7%A8%D7%99%D7%9D-%D7%A2%D7%9D-%D7%9E%D7%97%D7%A1%D7%9F-%D7%95%D7%97%D7%A0%D7%99%D7%94/), 2025-11-11). Driving time not verified.
- **Kirya.** Kaplan Street separates the IDF base (north of Kaplan) from the South Kirya business district (south of Kaplan), where Sarona and the project are (Wikipedia describes the split; the project's distance from Kaplan was not measured) ([Wikipedia, HaKirya](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/HaKirya), accessed 2026-09-16).
- **Culture, Habima, Rothschild.**
  - The Tel Aviv Museum of Art, the Performing Arts Center, Habima and the Cinematheque are "within walking distance" ([Shturem](https://shturem.co.il/en/projects/b-s-r-sarona-project/), accessed 2026-09-16).
  - The owner page claims Cinematheque 5 minutes, Habima Square 10 minutes and Rothschild 15 minutes, without stating the mode ([owner listing page](https://sharona-skyline-living.lovable.app/), undated).
  - Moovit puts the "האופרה/שד' שאול המלך" (Opera) bus stop 7 minutes from its Sarona reference point ([Moovit](https://moovitapp.com/index/en/public_transit-%D7%9E%D7%AA%D7%97%D7%9D_%D7%A9%D7%A8%D7%95%D7%A0%D7%94-Israel-site_33024977-1), accessed 2026-09-16).
- **Ichilov (Tel Aviv Sourasky Medical Center).** No sourced walk time. The straight-line distance between Wikipedia's coordinates for Azrieli Sarona Tower (32.07194N 34.78861E) and Ichilov (32.08056N 34.79000E) is about 970 m (computed 2026-09-16) ([Wikipedia, Azrieli Sarona Tower](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Azrieli_Sarona_Tower); [Wikipedia, Ichilov](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tel_Aviv_Sourasky_Medical_Center)). The towers are not at that reference point, so treat this as an order of magnitude only.
- **Beach.** No verified driving time or distance found.
- **Yarkon Park.** No verified distance. Wikipedia's single reference point for the park (32.10000N 34.81000E; park area 3.5 sq km) is about 3.7 km in a straight line from the Azrieli Sarona Tower coordinates (computed 2026-09-16). The nearest edge of the park is closer ([Wikipedia, Yarkon Park](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Yarkon_Park), accessed 2026-09-16).
- **Schools: official registration zones NOT verified** (the municipal site could not be fetched).
  - Madlan's Sarona neighborhood page lists these schools, without saying whether they are registration-zone schools or simply nearby ([Madlan area page](https://www.madlan.co.il/area-info/%D7%A9%D7%9B%D7%95%D7%A0%D7%94-%D7%A9%D7%A8%D7%95%D7%A0%D7%94-%D7%AA%D7%9C-%D7%90%D7%91%D7%99%D7%91-%D7%99%D7%A4%D7%95-%D7%99%D7%A9%D7%A8%D7%90%D7%9C), accessed 2026-09-16):
    - Elementary: "בית ספר גבעון" (grades 1-6, state, about 80 students per grade) and "בית ספר ביכורים - המכיל" (grades 1-6, state, about 72).
    - High school: "בית ספר עירוני א' לאמנויות" (grades 7-12, state, about 242) and "בית ספר פלך" (grades 7-12, state religious, about 35).
  - Inside the project: the kindergarten cluster at Arania 14א ([Project TLV](https://project-tlv.info/places/sarona/%D7%A4%D7%A8%D7%95%D7%99%D7%A7%D7%98-%D7%90%D7%A9%D7%9B%D7%95%D7%9C-%D7%92%D7%A0%D7%99%D7%9D-%D7%92%D7%A0%D7%99-%D7%A9%D7%A8%D7%95%D7%A0%D7%94-%D7%9E%D7%92%D7%93%D7%9C%D7%99-%D7%91%D7%A1%D7%A8/), accessed 2026-09-16).

## 6. Planned and ongoing developments nearby

- **Sarona Hotel (Nitsba)**, corner of HaArba'a Street and Begin Road, south of Azrieli Sarona Tower.
  - Wikipedia: 47 floors and 880 rooms planned; by a 2025 report the structure had reached the 36th floor above 5 basement and 5 foundation floors; no completion date; an arbitration dispute with Electra was reported in October 2022 ([Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sarona_Hotel), accessed 2026-09-16).
  - Project TLV: Begin 119, 45 floors and 800 rooms, still under construction in November 2025 photos ([Project TLV](https://project-tlv.info/new-projects/all/sarona/hotel/), accessed 2026-09-16).
  - **Conflict** on floors and rooms. Inference: it sits on the east side of the area, so it is unlikely to block west-facing sea views.
- **Landmark (AFI / Africa Israel and Melisron)**, immediately south at Arania Osvaldo 20 / HaArba'a 13-15 / Da Vinci 2-4.
  - Tower A: 39 office floors plus a performing arts center. Tower B: 30 office floors plus 11 residential floors. A Landmark tower won a CTBUH award for 2025 (reported June 2025) ([Project TLV](https://project-tlv.info/places/sarona/7-2/), accessed 2026-09-16).
  - The 2021 expansion approval brought the project to 166,000 sqm, with 116 apartments in Tower 2, at a cost of NIS 2.1 billion ([Globes English](https://en.globes.co.il/en/article-tel-aviv-sarona-landmark-project-expansion-approved-1001366461), 2021-04-06).
  - Already built. Check the southern outlook for units facing it.
- **Wiz campus** on Arania street, "behind the BSR buildings" (see 1.2) ([Globes English](https://en.globes.co.il/en/article-wiz-leases-five-floors-in-renovated-sarona-building-1001503536), 2025-03-02).
- **Spiral Tower, Azrieli Center:** 91 floors, 350 m, completion expected 2027 ([Wikipedia, Azrieli Center](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Azrieli_Center), accessed 2026-09-16). Inference: east of Begin Road, so it changes the eastern skyline, not the sea view.
- **Keren HaKirya:** in August 2013 the Tel Aviv Local Committee approved a mixed-use complex with 80- and 50-storey commercial towers and two 45-storey residential towers at Begin and Shaul HaMelech ([Wikipedia, HaKirya](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/HaKirya), accessed 2026-09-16). **Current status UNVERIFIED.**
- **IDF Kirya** ([Wikipedia, HaKirya](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/HaKirya), accessed 2026-09-16):
  - 2012 reports said IDF headquarters, or parts of it, would move out of the Kirya.
  - There are plans to relocate parts of the northern (military) section in favor of the light rail and private development.
  - Plans also exist for five new towers inside the base.
  - No 2025 to 2026 decision was found in this research.
- **South Kirya context.** A 2024 appraisal lists the surrounding projects ([TASE appraisal](https://mayafiles.tase.co.il/rpdf/1584001-1585000/P1584313-01.pdf), report dated 2024-03-28):
  - Office towers: HaArba'a towers, Platinum, Millennium, HaTichon, HaYovel (with government offices), Azrieli Sarona and Da Vinci.
  - Residential: 3 residential buildings above Sarona Market, and 2 "Da Vinci" residential towers by Canada Israel and Acro.
  - Also: the Nitsba hotel (about 40,000 sqm of hotel and 2,000 sqm of retail), Landmark, and B.S.R Sarona.
- **Transit** (details in section 5): Green Line 2028 to 2030, Purple Line 2027 to 2028, Metro tender launched 2026-08-24.
- **West view risk.** No approved tower plan between the project and the sea was identified, but this was not searched thoroughly (the search quota ran out), so it is not a clearance. Ask the broker from which floor the sea view is open, and check the Tel Aviv planning map for the blocks west of Leonardo da Vinci street.

## 7. Tel Aviv arnona zone for this address

- **NOT verified.** The Tel Aviv-Yafo municipality site returned an error (HTTP 472) and no other route was tried. No third-party source giving the zone for Arania Osvaldo street was found.
- Practical step: ask the owner for a recent arnona bill for the specific unit.

## 8. Points to confirm with the broker (from the gaps above)

- Tower (A, B or C), floor, and exact balcony direction. Is the sea view open or partial?
- Monthly va'ad bayit / management fee, who pays it, and the management company's name. Not public.
- Whether a parking space and a storage room come with the unit. In the 2021 plan, 180 units had no attached parking.
- Gym access and terms. One listing places the gym in Building C, for residents of all towers.
- Built sqm and balcony sqm of the 4.5-room unit, and what "originally 5 rooms" changed.
- A recent arnona bill, and the school registration zone for the exact address.
